name: pixelpress
description: Production-grade graphic and illustration prepress tools for Antigravity (AGY), featuring Real-ESRGAN 2x super-resolution + Spot-Color Unmixing (Topological True-Background Flood-Fill, Interior Solid CIELAB Guard, Pre-VTracer Speckle Consolidation, Internal Seam-Backing Underlay, and Boundary Fractional-Alpha Ray Unmixing with 9x9 Core Support) + (K+1) Cutout Spline VTracer SVG vectorization & canonical hex snapping, alongside continuous DTG/DTF alpha matting and raster screenprint separation.
